name: logicai-io/recsys2019
what_it_holds: 1st-place winning solution to RecSys Challenge 2019 (trivago). cpp/ feature extraction, data/ dir, publications/, src/ Python pipelines; ships a download_data.sh script rather than committing the raw data itself; 37 LightGBM ranker models with ensemble blending. Apache-2.0, 94 stars, 15 forks, 238 commits.
why_useful: A working, documented one-command pull-and-featurize pipeline for the trivago click-out dataset (once obtained from the official host) plus a full feature-engineering reference for turning OTA session logs into demand/price-sensitivity features -- reusable methodology for gap #17 (nowcasting methods) even if the raw data pull itself needs a ToS decision.
last_activity: unspecified; static since 2019 challenge, last seen with 238 commits
themes: Expedia and Hotels.com datasets (Expedia hotel recommendation Kaggle, personalized ranking ICDM 2013, Expedia scrapers), Trivago RecSys 2019, Kayak/Skyscanner scrapers

name: factden/expedia-hotel-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: Apify actor (JavaScript) scraping Expedia Group brands (Expedia, Hotels.com, Orbitz, Travelocity, Wotif, CheapTickets, ebookers) for guest ratings, category sub-ratings, review text, and owner responses; outputs CSV/JSON via Apify's platform API. Updated Sep 7 2026 (active/maintained).
why_useful: Live acquisition path for competitor hotel review volume/sentiment across all 7 Expedia Group brands at once -- a broader, actively maintained alternative to the Booking.com 515k-review Kaggle set already held; review-count trend could serve as a rough competitor demand/engagement proxy (gap #9). Requires running against a live commercial site, so per project rules this is catalogued as method only and left unrun.

name: omkarcloud/tripadvisor-scraper
what_it_holds: 212-star MIT-licensed scraper/API wrapper extracting hotel, restaurant, attraction and cruise data from TripAdvisor: names, ratings, review counts, pricing, coordinates, amenities, award badges, rankings. JSON via REST endpoints; also crawls property websites for emails/phones/social/tech stack. 45+ locales, 145+ currencies. Free tier 200 requests/month. No dataset files committed, only JSON response examples in docs.
why_useful: Could be used to build a hotel-review-velocity / rating-trend panel for the hotel comp set (MAR/HLT/hospitality demand read-through) as a non-Airbnb travel-demand proxy; catalogued as method only, not run.
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos

TripAdvisor review volume/ratings for hotels and restaurants by market is another leisure/travel-demand proxy, and could give a competitor/adjacent-lodging read (hotel review volume as an occupancy proxy) alongside the existing hotel RevPAR data.

name: factden/booking-com-scraper
what_it_holds: Apify-platform scraper for Booking.com: pulls hotel names, star ratings, guest scores, review counts, per-night/gross/net pricing, room availability, per-room rate breakdowns, review text with stay dates/room type/traveler type/owner responses, and forward-looking daily availability + minimum-price calendars. Ships hotels.sample.json and reviews.sample.json examples. MIT licensed, 6 commits.
why_useful: Directly extends the Booking.com data already held (515k Kaggle reviews, RecTour24) with a live pricing/availability puller -- closest thing found to a free realised-ADR/occupancy proxy for gap #2, if run against a fixed hotel panel over time to build a price time series.
license: MIT (consistent with sibling repos; not independently confirmed)
duplicate_of_holding: Adjacent to existing Booking.com Kaggle/RecTour24 holdings but adds live pricing capability they lack
